user.title: 2N Intercom
user.description: Connects to the intercom's HTTP API over HTTPS. Use an HTTP API account with access to I/O, switches and the event log.

import_legacy.description: Imports {count} intercoms ({titles}). Each keeps its device, entity IDs and history, and the old entry is removed. Automations on the `hass2n_event` event keep working.
